core_contributions.name: Validation downstream-regret selection of a transparent deterministic blend
core_contributions.one_sentence: 让预测权重服从储能削峰决策价值，而不只服从 MAE。
core_contributions.technical_statement: For each of the eight frozen buildings, DOEF searches a fixed convex grid for w_b in w_b·LightGBM + (1-w_b)·DayWeek using Validation mean daily battery peak-shaving regret versus Oracle, freezes w_b, and uses Test only for final evaluation.
core_contributions.difference: L015 selects a discrete forecast model via cross-building meta-learning for a PV-battery dispatchable feeder; L016 learns probabilistic linear-pool weights through nested downstream-cost optimization; L020 tunes a weighted historical-demand predictor with a task-specific surrogate shape error. DOEF instead uses a finite held-out Validation grid to select one deterministic DayWeek-LightGBM weight per building by realized constrained-dispatch regret, with no end-to-end retraining and an evaluation-only Test.
core_contributions.why_it_matters: The mechanism is lightweight, directly auditable, and preserves a strict selection/evaluation boundary while aligning the blend with the deployed peak-shaving objective.
core_contributions.report_wording: DOEF is a bounded method adaptation of value-oriented forecasting: it uses optimizer-derived Validation peak-shaving regret to select a transparent per-building deterministic blend before Test evaluation.
core_contributions.ppt_wording: Validation regret selects the blend—not MAE alone.
core_contributions.oral_wording: We do not claim to invent decision-focused forecasting. Our contribution is the specific auditable building-battery adaptation: a held-out Validation regret selects a simple deterministic blend, and Test never chooses it.
core_contributions.scope: Eight fixed office buildings; deterministic 24-hour-ahead point forecasts; frozen battery and daily-reset peak-shaving dispatch; one Validation and one Test period.
limitations: Not a theoretical or end-to-end DFL algorithm
Not the first use of forecast value or downstream cost for selection
Finite two-model blend and one battery protocol
prohibited_claims: 首次提出决策导向预测

core_contributions.name: Forecast-to-decision mismatch in the frozen multi-building experiment
core_contributions.one_sentence: 预测精度排名与储能削峰决策价值排名在冻结实验中并不等价。
core_contributions.technical_statement: Forecast-optimal and decision-optimal blend weights differ on 6/8 buildings; Phase 7 forecast and decision winners agree on 2/8 buildings; the exact within-building forecast/decision rank agreement across 32 building-method entries is 0.34375.
core_contributions.difference: The mismatch itself is known in prior work. DOEF contributes a reproducible descriptive instance under one fixed multi-building load-forecast and constrained peak-shaving protocol, including exact weight, winner, and rank evidence.
core_contributions.why_it_matters: It empirically motivates using both forecast metrics and downstream decision metrics rather than assuming one ranking is a proxy for the other.
core_contributions.report_wording: In the frozen eight-building experiment, forecast and decision rankings materially diverged: 6/8 blend optima differed, only 2/8 method winners agreed, and exact rank agreement was 0.344.
core_contributions.ppt_wording: 6/8 weights differ · 2/8 winners agree · rank agreement 0.344
core_contributions.oral_wording: Accuracy remains necessary, but in this experiment it was not sufficient to identify the best storage decision value.
core_contributions.scope: Descriptive evidence for eight selected office buildings and four Phase 7 methods plus the Phase 8 blend grid.
limitations: Does not imply forecast accuracy is unimportant
Does not establish population-wide rank mismatch
prohibited_claims: 首次发现预测与决策不一致
预测越准调度一定越差

core_contributions.name: Pre-Test representative-building evaluation with retained failures
core_contributions.one_sentence: 建筑代表性选择在 Test 结果前固定，并保留全部成功与失败案例。
core_contributions.technical_statement: From 296 office candidates, 82 passed fixed raw-availability and quality gates; eight buildings were then fixed through an anchor plus deterministic farthest-point sampling on Train-period morphology, without Validation/Test forecast or decision performance, and all resulting cases were retained.
core_contributions.difference: This is an evaluation-rigor contribution rather than a new forecast algorithm: it makes the building sample deterministic and performance-independent while documenting the eligibility/morphology distinction.
core_contributions.why_it_matters: It reduces the risk of selecting buildings because their Test outcomes flatter the method and makes negative cases part of the evidence.
core_contributions.report_wording: Among candidates passing predefined raw-coverage gates, the eight evaluation buildings were fixed before Test using Train-period morphology; forecast and decision performance did not choose them.
core_contributions.oral_wording: Eligibility checked raw availability over all predefined windows, while representative morphology was Train-only; we therefore do not claim every part of eligibility was Train-only.
core_contributions.scope: Evaluation design for the Building Data Genome 2 office subset.
limitations: Raw Validation/Test availability participates in eligibility
No unseen-building model or weight transfer
Eight buildings do not prove all-building generalization
prohibited_claims: 所有建筑选择完全只看 Train
8 栋建筑证明全体建筑泛化

supporting_contributions.statement: Machine-readable metric/unit semantics, claim audit, lineage and prediction-invariance evidence make the frozen result auditable.
supporting_contributions.caveat: A HIGH open Phase 7 clean-checkout loader/hash consistency defect prevents a complete fail-closed reproducibility claim.

supporting_contributions.statement: The framework connects 24-hour-ahead building load forecasts to constrained battery peak-shaving decisions in a lightweight simulated pipeline.
supporting_contributions.caveat: No real deployment, tariff savings, carbon reduction or renewable-consumption outcome was evaluated.

supporting_contributions.statement: Rejected robust, peak-aware and extreme CatBoost outcomes are preserved as stopping-rule and anti-cherry-picking evidence.
supporting_contributions.caveat: Negative results are not performance contributions and must remain scoped to their frozen experiments.

competition_narrative: Building battery operation ultimately consumes forecasts through a constrained scheduling problem, so forecast error alone is not the final value measure.
Prior art already establishes value-oriented forecasting and decision-focused selection; DOEF does not claim priority over that idea.
The frozen multi-building evidence shows forecast and storage-decision rankings were not equivalent in this scope.
DOEF therefore uses Validation battery regret to select a transparent DayWeek-LightGBM blend, then freezes the weight before Test.
The eight buildings were fixed before Test performance using Train-period morphology among raw-coverage-eligible candidates, and failures were retained.
The defensible competition position is a lightweight, transparent and auditable method adaptation for simulated building-battery peak shaving.
